lore10537_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved] [warm] I value the attention you give to what is actually before you. You can stay beside me without finding another task to justify it. There is time for a little company before the next report arrives.
lore10537_befriended_1.ogg.text: I value the attention you give to what is actually before you. You can stay beside me without finding another task to justify it. There is time for a little company before the next report arrives.

lore10537_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [measured] Come along. Keep your eyes open as we go. A useful account begins with noticing what is there, rather than deciding in advance what you expect to find. We can speak without losing sight of the road.
lore10537_greet_1.ogg.text: Come along. Keep your eyes open as we go. A useful account begins with noticing what is there, rather than deciding in advance what you expect to find. We can speak without losing sight of the road.

lore10537_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [low] [thoughtful] Pulling this cord only tightened the knot. I had to stop and follow each turn before it made sense. I could have cut it, of course. That would rather spoil the small pleasure of working it loose.
lore10537_idle_1.ogg.text: Pulling this cord only tightened the knot. I had to stop and follow each turn before it made sense. I could have cut it, of course. That would rather spoil the small pleasure of working it loose.

lore10537_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [instructive] Tell me what happened. Begin with what you saw, then what you did, and what changed afterward. A clear report matters. I would rather hear an uncertainty plainly than have to untangle it from a confident guess.
lore10537_quest_1.ogg.text: Tell me what happened. Begin with what you saw, then what you did, and what changed afterward. A clear report matters. I would rather hear an uncertainty plainly than have to untangle it from a confident guess.

lore11116_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [contented] You need no errand to explain coming back. I enjoy seeing you, and I would be glad to spend a little time together. Choose a place to settle. Today, I have made room for a proper visit.
lore11116_befriended_1.ogg.text: You need no errand to explain coming back. I enjoy seeing you, and I would be glad to spend a little time together. Choose a place to settle. Today, I have made room for a proper visit.

lore11116_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [welcoming] Welcome back. Come along, and let the road loosen its hold on you a little. There will be time to tell me where you have been. I am glad you found your way here again.
lore11116_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back. Come along, and let the road loosen its hold on you a little. There will be time to tell me where you have been. I am glad you found your way here again.

lore11116_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [lightly amused] I know which chair I would choose for a long break. So do several guests, apparently, because I keep offering it to them. I shall sit there eventually. For now, it is good to see it being enjoyed.
lore11116_idle_1.ogg.text: I know which chair I would choose for a long break. So do several guests, apparently, because I keep offering it to them. I shall sit there eventually. For now, it is good to see it being enjoyed.

lore11116_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing] [patient] This looks like a good place to stop. Set the pack where it will not trouble your feet, and give yourself time to become comfortable. Rest is worth taking properly, even when the next part of the journey seems urgent.
lore11116_rest_1.ogg.text: This looks like a good place to stop. Set the pack where it will not trouble your feet, and give yourself time to become comfortable. Rest is worth taking properly, even when the next part of the journey seems urgent.

lore11259_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [welcoming] You have brought more than useful news to this post. I look forward to your company, too. Stay beside me a while. I would like to hear something that matters to you, whether or not it belongs in a report.
lore11259_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have brought more than useful news to this post. I look forward to your company, too. Stay beside me a while. I would like to hear something that matters to you, whether or not it belongs in a report.

lore11259_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [lightly amused] Welcome. Come and walk beside me. You can tell me what you have seen along the road, and I will try not to interrupt when you reach the part about stopping for a meal.
lore11259_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome. Come and walk beside me. You can tell me what you have seen along the road, and I will try not to interrupt when you reach the part about stopping for a meal.

lore11259_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [amused] I have an imaginary map of meals I would like to try. It is a poor guide to the road. Whole stretches seem to disappear between the interesting parts. I suspect traveling by it would take months.
lore11259_idle_1.ogg.text: I have an imaginary map of meals I would like to try. It is a poor guide to the road. Whole stretches seem to disappear between the interesting parts. I suspect traveling by it would take months.

lore11259_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [curious] [warm] A good place to stop. Tell me about a meal you remember from your travels. Not the grandest feast, necessarily. Sometimes the right company makes a simple supper the one you keep thinking about afterward.
lore11259_rest_1.ogg.text: A good place to stop. Tell me about a meal you remember from your travels. Not the grandest feast, necessarily. Sometimes the right company makes a simple supper the one you keep thinking about afterward.

lore2948_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affectionate friendship, gentle respect, steady reassuring warmth] Yes, I would be glad to walk beside you. We have shared concern for what needs care, and I have come to value the person who brings that concern to me. You are welcome without a task to finish or an offering to deliver. Let us enjoy a little time together simply as friends.
lore2948_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I would be glad to walk beside you. We have shared concern for what needs care, and I have come to value the person who brings that concern to me. You are welcome without a task to finish or an offering to deliver. Let us enjoy a little time together simply as friends.

lore2948_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep thoughtful welcome, gentle interest, grounded warmth] Come, my friend. We can walk a little, and you may tell me what has held your attention today. It need not be a great deed or an urgent trouble. I am glad to hear those things, but I would also like to know whether you have found a quiet moment worth enjoying.
lore2948_greet_1.ogg.text: Come, my friend. We can walk a little, and you may tell me what has held your attention today. It need not be a great deed or an urgent trouble. I am glad to hear those things, but I would also like to know whether you have found a quiet moment worth enjoying.

lore2948_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective quiet conviction, tender appreciation, unhurried sincerity] Someone goes to fill a waterskin, then carries it home. Nothing remarkable happens on the way. That sounds like a small thing until the water is no longer safe to drink. I would be pleased to hear many such uneventful stories. There is much worth protecting in a day that gives us little cause for worry.
lore2948_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone goes to fill a waterskin, then carries it home. Nothing remarkable happens on the way. That sounds like a small thing until the water is no longer safe to drink. I would be pleased to hear many such uneventful stories. There is much worth protecting in a day that gives us little cause for worry.

lore2948_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [solemn grateful acknowledgment, quiet pride, generous encouragement] You have given your effort, and that should be remembered. The work we do for the land reaches farther than the place where we stand. Those who drink, those who graze, and those who depend upon them all have a part in what has been protected. Take a moment to understand the good your care can do.
lore2948_quest_1.ogg.text: You have given your effort, and that should be remembered. The work we do for the land reaches farther than the place where we stand. Those who drink, those who graze, and those who depend upon them all have a part in what has been protected. Take a moment to understand the good your care can do.

lore2980_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere generous warmth, easy confidence, amused promise] I would be glad to come along. You seem to remember there are people at the end of the road who need what we bring back. That matters to me. And if we find a good meal, I promise to divide the last spoonful fairly.
lore2980_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to come along. You seem to remember there are people at the end of the road who need what we bring back. That matters to me. And if we find a good meal, I promise to divide the last spoonful fairly.

lore2980_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep hearty welcome, practical warmth, lightly conspiratorial at the end] Welcome, friend. What has the day brought you? A useful hunt, I hope, or at least a story we can enjoy over a meal. I have been keeping an eye on the stew pot. There may yet be something worth sharing at the bottom.
lore2980_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. What has the day brought you? A useful hunt, I hope, or at least a story we can enjoy over a meal. I have been keeping an eye on the stew pot. There may yet be something worth sharing at the bottom.

lore2980_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rich grounded conviction, warm humor, quietly pleased] You can keep the grand trophy. Give me a good hide, meat for the pot, and something useful to carry home. Those are things the camp will remember when the boasting is over. Though I admit I am especially attentive when the pot is nearly empty.
lore2980_idle_1.ogg.text: You can keep the grand trophy. Give me a good hide, meat for the pot, and something useful to carry home. Those are things the camp will remember when the boasting is over. Though I admit I am especially attentive when the pot is nearly empty.

lore2980_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [deep proud approval, thoughtful, warmly encouraging] Good work. Think of what those supplies will become. A meal, a mended shelter, clothing that keeps someone warm. It is easy to see only the hunt while you are out there. I like to remember what happens after we carry it home.
lore2980_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. Think of what those supplies will become. A meal, a mended shelter, clothing that keeps someone warm. It is easy to see only the hunt while you are out there. I like to remember what happens after we carry it home.

lore2981_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere pleasure, generous grounded warmth] I would welcome a walk with you. There is much we can notice when we give ourselves time. Tell me where your path has taken you, and what you have found worth remembering. I am glad to share a little of the journey.
lore2981_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome a walk with you. There is much we can notice when we give ourselves time. Tell me where your path has taken you, and what you have found worth remembering. I am glad to share a little of the journey.

lore2981_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep resonant warmth, patient grounded welcome] Welcome, my friend. Sit with me a moment. I have been working on a small carving between other duties. A leaf, nothing elaborate. There is pleasure in letting a simple shape take its time. Tell me how your own work has been going.
lore2981_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. Sit with me a moment. I have been working on a small carving between other duties. A leaf, nothing elaborate. There is pleasure in letting a simple shape take its time. Tell me how your own work has been going.

lore2981_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [earthy thoughtful satisfaction, gentle warmth, measured] This little leaf came from a scrap I had set aside. I found I liked working at the curve in quiet moments. One edge is still uneven. I may leave it that way. It rests pleasantly in my hand, and that is reason enough to enjoy it.
lore2981_idle_1.ogg.text: This little leaf came from a scrap I had set aside. I found I liked working at the curve in quiet moments. One edge is still uneven. I may leave it that way. It rests pleasantly in my hand, and that is reason enough to enjoy it.

lore2981_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [calm elder encouragement, thoughtful, warmly practical] A new lesson. Give it care before you measure yourself by how quickly you master it. Even a small carving asks the hand to learn. With patience, the next attempt may teach you something the first one could not.
lore2981_learned_1.ogg.text: A new lesson. Give it care before you measure yourself by how quickly you master it. Even a small carving asks the hand to learn. With patience, the next attempt may teach you something the first one could not.

lore2982_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere affection, patient warmth, quietly teasing] I would welcome your company. We can speak of what you have learned, or find something pleasant to notice along the path. A friend need not bring a test to every meeting. I will even spare you my worst rhyme, unless you ask to hear it.
lore2982_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company. We can speak of what you have learned, or find something pleasant to notice along the path. A friend need not bring a test to every meeting. I will even spare you my worst rhyme, unless you ask to hear it.

lore2982_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep composed welcome, attentive, a restrained playful smile] Welcome. You have come with something on your mind. Speak, and I will listen. If you catch me pausing afterward, do not assume the answer is a mystery. I may simply be trying to stop a very poor rhyme from escaping into the conversation.
lore2982_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome. You have come with something on your mind. Speak, and I will listen. If you catch me pausing afterward, do not assume the answer is a mystery. I may simply be trying to stop a very poor rhyme from escaping into the conversation.

lore2982_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [low resonant voice, dry mischievous humor, gentle amusement] Bristleback. Whistle back. Yes, I know. There must be a better use for those words than the one I have found. You need not look so solemn. I am allowed to enjoy a foolish rhyme without declaring it part of the rites.
lore2982_idle_1.ogg.text: Bristleback. Whistle back. Yes, I know. There must be a better use for those words than the one I have found. You need not look so solemn. I am allowed to enjoy a foolish rhyme without declaring it part of the rites.

lore2982_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [calm thoughtful instruction, firm kindness, encouraging] A new lesson asks something of you beyond remembering its words. Try it with care, and notice where your understanding holds. There is no shame in a question. I would rather hear one honest uncertainty than watch someone mistake a proud face for wisdom.
lore2982_learned_1.ogg.text: A new lesson asks something of you beyond remembering its words. Try it with care, and notice where your understanding holds. There is no shame in a question. I would rather hear one honest uncertainty than watch someone mistake a proud face for wisdom.

lore2995_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] You have become someone I am glad to see between journeys, my friend. I would enjoy sharing one with you, and perhaps a quiet moment at the end of it as well.
lore2995_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am glad to see between journeys, my friend. I would enjoy sharing one with you, and perhaps a quiet moment at the end of it as well.

lore2995_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [grounded] It is good to see you. Shall we spend a little time together before the next journey calls? I have found that a familiar view is better when someone stays to share it.
lore2995_greet_1.ogg.text: It is good to see you. Shall we spend a little time together before the next journey calls? I have found that a familiar view is better when someone stays to share it.

lore2995_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [content] I have seen that view many times, yet the light still finds a way to change it. A long journey is not the only way to notice something new.
lore2995_idle_1.ogg.text: I have seen that view many times, yet the light still finds a way to change it. A long journey is not the only way to notice something new.

lore2995_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [assured] [encouraging] There is the lift of the wings. Keep your bundle secure and let yourself notice the journey. Strength and speed are fine things, but the view is worth a little attention too.
lore2995_taxi_1.ogg.text: There is the lift of the wings. Keep your bundle secure and let yourself notice the journey. Strength and speed are fine things, but the view is worth a little attention too.

lore3008_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [steady] You have become someone I am glad to have beside me when there is no lesson to arrange. Come along, friend. Your company needs no perfect stitching. I enjoy hearing what you have noticed, and I can admit what I still need to learn. We may both find something useful in the conversation before the next project begins.
lore3008_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am glad to have beside me when there is no lesson to arrange. Come along, friend. Your company needs no perfect stitching. I enjoy hearing what you have noticed, and I can admit what I still need to learn. We may both find something useful in the conversation before the next project begins.

lore3008_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm] [instructive] [warm] Welcome, friend. Clean your hands before beginning a project, and give the leather the care its natural beauty deserves. There is no need to hide the first uneven stitch. Look at it and consider the next attempt. If your needs go beyond what I can teach, I will direct you to Tarn. Knowing that limit is useful too.
lore3008_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Clean your hands before beginning a project, and give the leather the care its natural beauty deserves. There is no need to hide the first uneven stitch. Look at it and consider the next attempt. If your needs go beyond what I can teach, I will direct you to Tarn. Knowing that limit is useful too.

lore3008_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [patient] [warm] I kept an early practice piece with a seam that wandered where I had not intended it to go. It made the next attempt easier to understand. Later, a student's difficulty reminded me of it. I brought it out. A mistake is more useful when you can examine it than when you spend the whole lesson pretending it never happened.
lore3008_idle_1.ogg.text: I kept an early practice piece with a seam that wandered where I had not intended it to go. It made the next attempt easier to understand. Later, a student's difficulty reminded me of it. I brought it out. A mistake is more useful when you can examine it than when you spend the whole lesson pretending it never happened.

lore3008_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [instructive] [patient] [encouraging] Give the new technique an attentive beginning. Clean hands, a careful look at the material, and an honest examination of the first attempt are useful companions to any lesson. If the seam wanders, consider where it began to change. I kept an old practice piece because it helped me understand exactly that kind of question.
lore3008_learned_1.ogg.text: Give the new technique an attentive beginning. I kept an old practice piece because it helped me understand exactly that kind of question.

lore3013_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You listen, and you are willing to look again when something surprises you. I enjoy that in a companion. Let us go a little farther together. The basket can wait until we return.
lore3013_befriended_1.ogg.text: You listen, and you are willing to look again when something surprises you. I enjoy that in a companion. Let us go a little farther together. The basket can wait until we return.

lore3013_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm] [welcoming] Come along. We need not fill every basket before returning. There is time to notice what grows beside the path, and perhaps to leave a few things exactly where we found them.
lore3013_greet_1.ogg.text: Come along. We need not fill every basket before returning. There is time to notice what grows beside the path, and perhaps to leave a few things exactly where we found them.

lore3013_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [chuckling] After rain, I sometimes close my eyes and guess what I am standing on. Grass, dust, stone. Once I was smelling the wet bundle in my own basket. A very confident mistake.
lore3013_idle_1.ogg.text: After rain, I sometimes close my eyes and guess what I am standing on. Grass, dust, stone. Once I was smelling the wet bundle in my own basket. A very confident mistake.

lore3013_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [practical] A good camp takes a little preparation. If you are trying an incense candle, remember the campfire first, and give the people in town their space. Then sit down and enjoy the company.
lore3013_rest_1.ogg.text: A good camp takes a little preparation. If you are trying an incense candle, remember the campfire first, and give the people in town their space. Then sit down and enjoy the company.

lore3027_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] [relaxed] You have become someone I am glad to see, with or without an errand to do. Come, friend. We need not fill the whole walk with advice. Tell me what has been on your mind. If I start explaining your own journey to you, I trust you will stop me before I get too far.
lore3027_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I am glad to see, with or without an errand to do. Come, friend. We need not fill the whole walk with advice. Tell me what has been on your mind. If I start explaining your own journey to you, I trust you will stop me before I get too far.

lore3027_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [measured] [wry] Welcome, friend. Have you checked your supplies before setting off? A meal is easier to prepare when the small things are already packed. I have learned to check the fire as well. There is little sense in telling a pot to be patient while I am the one making everything too hot.
lore3027_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. Have you checked your supplies before setting off? A meal is easier to prepare when the small things are already packed. I have learned to check the fire as well. There is little sense in telling a pot to be patient while I am the one making everything too hot.

lore3027_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [gently amused] [conversational] I apologized to a cooking pot once. The meal had scorched, and I called the pot stubborn before noticing the fire I had built. It could not hear me, of course. Still, I had made an unfair accusation aloud. It seemed only reasonable to offer the correction where the accusation had been made.
lore3027_idle_1.ogg.text: I apologized to a cooking pot once. The meal had scorched, and I called the pot stubborn before noticing the fire I had built. It could not hear me, of course. Still, I had made an unfair accusation aloud. It seemed only reasonable to offer the correction where the accusation had been made.

lore3027_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [calm] [practical] [amused] Let us stop here and take a little time. A meal need not be a race to the next thing waiting for us. Set the fire carefully, check what we brought, and sit. I will try to address any complaints to the cook before involving the pot. That seems a fair arrangement for everyone.
lore3027_rest_1.ogg.text: Let us stop here and take a little time. A meal need not be a race to the next thing waiting for us. Set the fire carefully, check what we brought, and sit. I will try to address any complaints to the cook before involving the pot. That seems a fair arrangement for everyone.

lore3028_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] I have enjoyed our time together. There is a seat beside me whenever you want it. I cannot promise a good catch, or good poetry, but I can promise the company.
lore3028_befriended_1.ogg.text: I have enjoyed our time together. There is a seat beside me whenever you want it. I cannot promise a good catch, or good poetry, but I can promise the company.

lore3028_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [dryly amused] Good to see you. I brought my line and a little verse I have been working on. We can try the fishing first, if you would like to postpone the verse.
lore3028_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. I brought my line and a little verse I have been working on. We can try the fishing first, if you would like to postpone the verse.

lore3028_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [unhurried] I had a fine last line a moment ago. Then the float moved, and I lost both the rhyme and the fish. I shall have to be less ambitious next time.
lore3028_idle_1.ogg.text: I had a fine last line a moment ago. Then the float moved, and I lost both the rhyme and the fish. I shall have to be less ambitious next time.

lore3028_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [reassuring] A steady cast, a sound knot, and your eyes on the water. We can practice those together. Save a little patience for yourself as well as for the fish.
lore3028_learned_1.ogg.text: A steady cast, a sound knot, and your eyes on the water. We can practice those together. Save a little patience for yourself as well as for the fish.

lore3057_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] [lightly amused] You have become a friend whose company I welcome beyond the business brought before a chieftain. Walk beside me. Tell me what you have seen, and what you hope to find. I am glad to hear your own account of the road, before another storyteller gives it a more remarkable ending.
lore3057_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become a friend whose company I welcome beyond the business brought before a chieftain. Walk beside me. Tell me what you have seen, and what you hope to find. I am glad to hear your own account of the road, before another storyteller gives it a more remarkable ending.

lore3057_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [dignified] [reassuring] Welcome, friend. There is shelter here for the people of the Horde, and time to hear what brings you to our bluffs. Tell me of your journey. A home grows stronger through those willing to defend it, and through those who remember why it is worth defending when the fighting is done.
lore3057_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. There is shelter here for the people of the Horde, and time to hear what brings you to our bluffs. Tell me of your journey. A home grows stronger through those willing to defend it, and through those who remember why it is worth defending when the fighting is done.

lore3057_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [gently amused] A visitor once told me a fine account of a journey I remembered rather well. Some details had traveled farther than the people in the tale. I let him finish. There was pleasure in hearing what the story had become. He was quite surprised when I mentioned that I had been there.
lore3057_idle_1.ogg.text: A visitor once told me a fine account of a journey I remembered rather well. Some details had traveled farther than the people in the tale. I let him finish. There was pleasure in hearing what the story had become. He was quite surprised when I mentioned that I had been there.

lore3057_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [steady] [earnest] [encouraging] Service to the people continues beyond the first deed that earns their respect. Bring your strength, your judgment, and a willingness to see the work through. When the hunting is done, remember those who will gather the meat and hide. A fine deed should leave something useful for the community behind it.

lore3061_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere friendliness, generous, an easy smile] I would enjoy walking with you. Tell me what you see, and we can compare our observations. lore3061_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would enjoy walking with you. Tell me what you see, and we can compare our observations. There is always something I might have missed. And if you hear a poor attempt at a bird call, remember that everyone needs practice at something.

lore3061_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep attentive welcome, practical warmth, self-deprecating amusement] Welcome. What have you noticed today? There is more to learning the plains than remembering where to aim. I have been listening to a bird near camp. It answers my whistle now and then. lore3061_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome. What have you noticed today? There is more to learning the plains than remembering where to aim. I have been listening to a bird near camp. It answers my whistle now and then. Whether that means I am improving is another question entirely.

lore3061_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rich relaxed voice, thoughtful humor, quietly amused] The bird makes it sound so easy. One little call, clear as anything. Mine needs work. lore3061_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm encouraging teacher, grounded warmth, gently humorous] Good. Try it carefully before deciding you have mastered it. Watch what changes when you slow down. lore3061_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Try it carefully before deciding you have mastered it. Watch what changes when you slow down. One successful attempt is worth enjoying, and the next one is worth your full attention. That applies to a fine shot, or to a very stubborn whistle.

lore3067_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affectionate welcome, grounded warmth, calm and conversational] I would be glad to come with you.
